title: Page Hub adoption declaration
description: An explicit declaration of the batch of Publications Page Hub should adopt. Page Hub never infers Publication boundaries from storage; every proposed Project prefix, Publication path, object key, entry point, routing mode, and public-route probe is named here. A batch may mix Projects, multi-object sites, Root Publications, exact-file routing, directory-index routing, and fallback routing. Adopting never writes, copies, or deletes storage objects.

publications.description: The complete adoption batch. The operator approves the batch as one unit; any rejected candidate rejects the whole batch.

prefix.description: Single top-level path segment owned by the Project. Must not be the reserved '_page-hub'. Several Publications may share one Project.

displayName.description: Optional human display name; defaults to the exact Project prefix.

path.description: Exact publication path: the project prefix itself (Root Publication) or a path beside other Publication paths inside the Project. A path nested inside another declared Publication path is rejected as ambiguous. Trailing slashes and '.', '..' segments are rejected.

displayName.description: Optional human display name; defaults to the publication path's last segment.

entryPoint.description: Exact object key used as the entry point. Must be part of the declared object set. Character case is preserved exactly.

routingMode.description: exact_file serves one object at the publication path; directory_index serves the entry point for the publication path and subpaths; fallback serves the entry point for any unmatched subpath.

items.description: Exact bucket object key: the publication path itself (exact-file Publications) or the publication path plus a relative suffix. During adoption the batch must cover the complete bucket; any undeclared object stops planning.

probes.description: Public routes whose behavior adoption must preserve. Planning performs every probe, records the observed status, content type, and body digest in the digest-bound plan, and rejects the plan when an observed status differs from the expected one. Committing repeats the probes immediately before the catalog transaction.

path.description: Probe path relative to the publication path. The empty string addresses the publication path itself; anything else is one or more clean relative segments beneath it.

expectStatus.description: The HTTP status the public route must return for adoption to preserve declared behavior.
